note: Research use only. Not for clinical decisions. Expert review has not yet been done. Every reading and check is automated.

gate.rule: interpretable only when at least 10 drugs have both AUC and Cmax tested against held-out studies (leave one study out, 2-fold band)

tiers.label: usable oral AUC and Cmax observations exist
and another study of the drug has a usable clearance
and, for Cmax, another study has a time of peak concentration

bound.limiting_factor: data: too few drugs have a second independent study with a clearance and a time of peak concentration

earlier_release.note: before the strict check (every value both readers agree on); its one drug with both metrics tested was dasatinib, through the unit error, and it failed

claim.text: AUC was within 2-fold of held-out studies in the 3 drugs where it could be tested (11 of 11 points, Wilson 95 % 0.74-1.00). Cmax could not be tested for any drug. The gate needs 10 drugs with both and has 0, so no statement is made about the model kit as a whole.

earlier_verdicts.note: earlier automated review verdicts, re-used; not a fresh measurement

cross_study_check.decision: not met: the earlier automated review passes judged the withheld values correct (they check the reading against the source, and the source itself carries the unit error), so the check stays switched off

rows.claim: ClinicalTrials.gov values that pass the strict check are read correctly
rows.detail: 125 of 126 values correct in a census of 14 studies, judged by two automated review passes, not by experts. Covers 336 of the 2,565 values the readers agree on (13 %).

rows.claim: AUC is predicted within 2-fold for held-out studies
rows.detail: Only 3 drugs (apremilast, repaglinide, talazoparib), 7 studies. Each point is predicted by a set built without its study. Says nothing about other drugs.

rows.claim: Cmax is predicted within 2-fold for held-out studies
rows.detail: No drug has a held-out study with a Cmax and another study with a time of peak concentration, which the set needs for the absorption rate.

rows.claim: The model kit is accurate across drugs (the gate)
rows.detail: The gate is interpretable only with at least 10 drugs that have both AUC and Cmax tested. Today: 0. Upper bound with the current data: 0.

rows.claim: A drug's parameter set is validated (AUC and Cmax both within 2-fold)
rows.detail: 0 of 404 drugs: a drug is validated only when both AUC and Cmax are tested, and no drug has both. 8 drugs have a parameter set, 2 of them complete.

rows.claim: Values from article tables and FDA review tables are precise enough to publish
rows.detail: Both failed the pre-registered rule (lower 95 % bound at least 0.90) and are held back.

rows.claim: A value posted with a wrong unit is withheld
rows.detail: A pre-registered cross-study check withholds the known case (dasatinib clearance posted in mL/h, about 1,000-fold off), but it did not meet its own decision rule and is switched off. Such values can still be shown. A drug with only one study cannot be checked this way.

rows.claim: The readers find every value a source reports
rows.detail: Recall needs experts to annotate whole documents.

rows.claim: Predictions for children, older adults, or kidney or liver impairment
rows.detail: Values from these populations are excluded from building and testing sets.

rows.claim: Experts have checked the values and the method
rows.detail: Expert review has not yet been done.
